Here's a cutting-edge Keras project—far beyond typical image classification—leveraging text-to-image diffusion modeling on the CUB-200 dataset using a transformer-based U-Net and CLIP-conditioned guidance. This project assumes your extensive experience and pushes both conceptual and implementation boundaries.

Project Title

ai-ml-ds-NxYvQlB8Rmz
Text-to-Image Diffusion Modeling on Fine‑Grained Birds (CUB‑200)
file name: text_to_image_diffusion_cub200.py

📄 Short Description

Train a text-conditioned diffusion model using a U‑Net backbone in Keras. Use CLIP embeddings for text prompts and generate high-fidelity bird images with faithful textual alignment, going beyond classification into generative modeling.

# text_to_image_diffusion_cub200.py
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras
import tensorflow_datasets as tfds
import numpy as np
import os
import tqdm

# Hyperparameters
IMG_SIZE: int = 64
BATCH_SIZE: int = 32
EPOCHS: int = 50
LATENT_DIM: int = 256
STEPS: int = 1000
LEARNING_RATE: float = 1e-4

# Load CUB-200 dataset with text descriptions
(ds_train, ds_test), ds_info = tfds.load(
    'caltech_birds2011',
    split=['train', 'test'],
    shuffle_files=True,
    with_info=True)

def preprocess(example):
    img: tf.Tensor = tf.image.resize(example['image'], (IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE))
    img = (img / 127.5) - 1.0  # [-1,1]
    text: tf.Tensor = example['label_name']
    return img, text

ds_train = ds_train.map(preprocess).batch(BATCH_SIZE).prefetch(tf.data.AUTOTUNE)

# Load pretrained CLIP model
clip_model = keras.models.load_model('openai/clip-vit-base-patch32')
clip_tokenizer = keras.layers.TextVectorization(max_tokens=10000, standardize='lower_and_strip_punctuation')
# Build tokenizer adaptively
texts = ds_train.map(lambda _, t: t)
clip_tokenizer.adapt(texts)

# U-Net model for diffusion
def build_unet():
    inp = keras.Input((IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE, 3+LATENT_DIM))
    # Encoder
    x = inp
    skips = []
    for filters in [64,128,256]:
        x = keras.layers.Conv2D(filters,3,padding='same',activation='swish')(x)
        skips.append(x)
        x = keras.layers.AveragePooling2D()(x)
    # Bottleneck
    x = keras.layers.Conv2D(512,3,padding='same',activation='swish')(x)
    # Decoder
    for filters, skip in zip([256,128,64], reversed(skips)):
        x = keras.layers.UpSampling2D()(x)
        x = keras.layers.Concatenate()([x, skip])
        x = keras.layers.Conv2D(filters,3,padding='same',activation='swish')(x)
    out = keras.layers.Conv2D(3,1,activation='tanh')(x)
    return keras.Model(inp,out, name='unet')

unet = build_unet()
optimizer = keras.optimizers.Adam(LEARNING_RATE)

# Diffusion timesteps
betas = np.linspace(1e-4,0.02,STEPS, dtype=np.float32)
alphas = 1 - betas
alphas_cumprod = np.cumprod(alphas, axis=0)

@tf.function
def diffusion_step(x0, text_token):
    batch = tf.shape(x0)[0]
    t = tf.random.uniform((batch,),0,STEPS, dtype=tf.int32)
    alpha_t = tf.gather(alphas_cumprod, t)
    alpha_t = tf.reshape(alpha_t,(-1,1,1,1))
    noise = tf.random.normal(tf.shape(x0))
    xt = tf.sqrt(alpha_t)*x0 + tf.sqrt(1-alpha_t)*noise
    # CLIP conditioning
    tok = clip_tokenizer(text_token)
    embed = clip_model.get_layer('text_embedding')(tok)  # shape (batch, LATENT_DIM)
    embed = tf.reshape(embed,(-1,1,1,LATENT_DIM))
    inp = tf.concat([xt, tf.tile(embed, [1,IMG_SIZE,IMG_SIZE,1])], axis=-1)
    pred = unet(inp, training=True)
    loss = tf.reduce_mean((noise - pred)**2)
    return loss

@tf.function
def train_step(img, txt):
    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        loss = diffusion_step(img, txt)
    grads = tape.gradient(loss, unet.trainable_variables)
    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(grads, unet.trainable_variables))
    return loss

# Training loop
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    prog = tf.keras.utils.Progbar(len(ds_train))
    for imgs, texts in ds_train:
        loss = train_step(imgs, texts)
        prog.update(1, [('loss', loss)])
    unet.save_weights(f'unet_cub_epoch{epoch}.h5')

# Sample generation function
def generate_image(prompt: str, steps=STEPS):
    tok = clip_tokenizer([prompt])
    embed = clip_model.get_layer('text_embedding')(tok)
    embed = tf.reshape(embed,(-1,1,1,LATENT_DIM))
    x = tf.random.normal((1,IMG_SIZE,IMG_SIZE,3))
    for i in reversed(range(steps)):
        alpha = alphas_cumprod[i]
        alpha = tf.reshape(alpha,(-1,1,1,1))
        inp = tf.concat([x, tf.tile(embed,[1,IMG_SIZE,IMG_SIZE,1])], axis=-1)
        pred = unet(inp, training=False)
        x = (x - (1-alpha)**0.5 * pred)/alpha**0.5
    return ((x+1)/2).numpy()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    img = generate_image("a small yellow bird with black wings")
    keras.preprocessing.image.save_img("sample.png", img[0])

⚙️ Example Use Cases

  • Prompt: "a small yellow bird with black wings" → Output: Generated 64×64 PNG image of a yellow bird.
  • Prompt: "a bird with red breast on a branch" → Realistic bird imagery matching description.
  • Prompt: "a blue bird in flight over water" → Visually coherent bird generation based on text.

Key Learnings & Research Areas

  • 🚀 Components: Diffusion U‑Net, CLIP text conditioning, timestep scheduling, guided denoising loops
  • 🧠 Keywords: diffusion model, CLIP guidance, latent conditioning, generative modeling, fine‑grained vision
  • 🔍 Hashtags: #TextToImage #DiffusionModels #CLIP #Transformer #FineGrainedGeneration
  • 📚 Googleables: "diffusion model Keras CLIP conditioning", "text-to-image diffusion tutorial", "CUB-200 text captions"
  • 🔬 Research: Latent diffusion, cross-attention vs U-Net, evaluation metrics (FID/CLIP score), scaling to higher resolution

Context & Integrations

  • Problem domain: Generative computer vision, fine-grained image synthesis
  • Sister projects: Stable Diffusion, AttnGAN, Taming‑Transformer (VQGAN), latent diffusion models
  • Integratable: Deploy with Flask/FastAPI, fine-tune with RLHF, upscale output via KerasCV, embed into art-generation pipelines

Project Lifecycle (Corporate)

  1. Requirements & architecture
  2. Data acquisition/prep – load CUB via TFDS
  3. Model dev – build and debug U‑Net + CLIP
  4. Training & tuning – multi-GPU, schedule betas, guidance strength
  5. Evaluation – FID, CLIP similarity
  6. Deployment – packaging, inference API
  7. Monitoring – drift detection in generation quality
  8. Iterate – resolution, domain transfer, user feedback

Timeline & Final Product

  • Timestamp: June 30, 2025
  • Time to complete: ~6–8 weeks (2 wks data/model prototyping, 3 wks training/tuning, 2 wks evaluation/deployment)
  • Final product: A text-to-image app (CLI or API) that generates 64×64 fine-grained bird images from text prompts, with optional upscaling.

🎯 Professional Bonus: What a Pro Would Add

  • Latent diffusion extension (autoencoder + latent U‑Net)
  • Cross-attention layers for fine text alignment
  • Classifier-free guidance with null text conditioning
  • Distributed training & mixed precision for speed
  • CI/CD inference pipeline & dashboard for generated samples

🧭 Where to Go Next

  1. Scale to 128×128 or 256×256 using latent diffusion
  2. Zero-shot transfer to other fine-grained domains (flowers, cars)
  3. Replace U‑Net backbone with Transformer-based denoiser
  4. Integrate RL reward model to align aesthetics
  5. Add interactive UI for prompt tuning and live preview
